mapper.select:
select FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID id,concat_ws('', FINPROD_MARKET_ID ,':', FINPROD_ABBR ) text from FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodTypeProd}
and ( FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',#{search},'%') or FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',#{search},'%') )

select SCI.ACCT_NO id, concat_ws('',SCI.ACCT_NO , ':', SCI.ACCT_NAME) text from STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI,STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA where SCI.ACCT_NO = SFPA.ACCT_NO
and (SCI.ACCT_NO like concat('%', #{search}, '%') or SCI.ACCT_NAME like concat('%', #{search}, '%'))
and SCI.ACCT_NO IN (#{initValue})
GROUP BY SCI.ACCT_NO,SCI.ACCT_NAME
select fee_id from mst_feeinfo where fee_type=#{feeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LIMIT 1

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text, CONCAT_WS('', CUSTOMER_TYPE,',' , IS_ISSUER , ',' , IS_FINANCIER , ',' , IS_ASSTE_MANAGER , ',' , IS_TRUSTER , ',' , IS_GUARANTEE , ',' , IS_PLEDGOR , ',' , IS_SALER , ',' , IS_DEPOSIT_BANK , ',' , IS_INVEST_ADVISER ) object FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where 1=1
AND IS_TRUSTER IS NOT NULL
and (CUSTOMER_ID like concat('%', #{search}, '%') or CUSTOMER_NAME like concat('%', #{search}, '%'))
and CUSTOMER_ID = #{initValue}
